terra.title: Terra: property freshness and licensed intelligence

sources.title: Regrid October parcel refresh
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: Commercial data delivery requires an applicable license.

sources.title: Cotality Claude connector
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: Customer authentication and licensed fields required; SZL entitlement unverified.

sources.title: ATTOM Semantic Views
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: ATTOM/Snowflake access required. Page date Oct 12; release dateline Oct 13.

developments.source_fact: Regrid reports 30,044,022 parcels refreshed across 635 counties, with average parcel age of 127 days.
developments.product_inference: Track parcel source age separately from retrieval time and show county coverage.

developments.source_fact: Cotality launched a licensed MCP-backed Claude connector; ATTOM announced Semantic Views v1.0 for Snowflake property data.
developments.product_inference: Evaluate stable property identity and versioned joins before enabling natural-language ownership analysis.

opportunities.title: Preserve property freshness and identity
opportunities.proposal: Add source timestamps, county coverage, provider IDs and conflict handling to Terra enrichments.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated refreshes do not duplicate parcels.
Conflicting provider identities require review.
Every result exposes source age and allowed fields.
dependencies: Licensed sample data and usage rights

sources.title: OFAC October 8 list action
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: Use official list snapshots and corrections; human compliance review remains required.

sources.title: IMO Senegal digitalization assessment
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: Assessment and roadmap; no public operational API announced.

developments.source_fact: OFAC published vessel/company additions and two vessel delistings on October 8.
developments.product_inference: Version vessel screening by stable identifiers and retain additions, corrections and removals.

developments.source_fact: IMO reported an October 5-9 Dakar maritime-single-window assessment.
developments.product_inference: Track port digitalization as a future integration, pending actual data access.

opportunities.title: Replay sanctions changes by vessel identity
opportunities.proposal: Create a dated IMO-keyed list-change history for maritime screening.
acceptance_criteria: Add/update/remove fixtures replay idempotently.
Same-name vessels remain distinct.
Stale source retrieval yields unknown status.

sources.title: Microsoft PQC authentication readiness guidance
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: New guidance about an August pilot; pilot certificates are for nonproduction testing.

developments.source_fact: Microsoft's October 8 guidance recommends inventorying certificate dependencies; the described pilot began August 27 and excludes production trust.
developments.product_inference: Map owners, trust anchors and upgrade dependencies before considering cryptographic migration.

opportunities.title: Inventory certificate dependencies
opportunities.proposal: Extend defensive asset inventory with certificate algorithm, expiry, issuer and service owner.
acceptance_criteria: Every in-scope service has owner and issuer metadata.
Unknown vendor support is explicit.
Pilot tests remain isolated from production trust.

lyte.title: Lyte and A11oy: correlation and runtime budgets

sources.title: OBI trace-log correlation
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: Requires compatible Linux/kernel privileges and synchronous logging; verify workload fit.

sources.title: Cloudflare on-demand Worker profiling
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: Requires authenticated account access and sufficient traffic on the selected version.

sources.title: Cloudflare Clef hosted-model changes
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: Provider access and per-model capability/license checks remain unverified for SZL.

developments.source_fact: OBI describes trace context enrichment for stdout/stderr; Cloudflare added on-demand CPU/memory profiling for active Workers and Durable Objects.
developments.product_inference: Bind incident traces and profiles to exact deployed revisions; pilot correlation only on eligible hosts.

developments.source_fact: Cloudflare reduced hosted Clef-flash context from 64k to 24k and introduced multimodal Clef-omni.
developments.product_inference: Record provider-specific context limits and reject or reroute oversized requests before inference.

opportunities.title: Attach performance evidence to releases
opportunities.proposal: Capture authorized Worker/version profiles with source revision and latency/error comparisons.
acceptance_criteria: Profile receipt names Worker version and source SHA.
Capture uses representative traffic.
Comparison includes latency and error-rate regression checks.

opportunities.title: Validate model context budgets
opportunities.proposal: Version hosted model capabilities and run explicit overflow/fallback tests.
acceptance_criteria: Requests over the provider limit are rejected or explicitly rerouted.
Model revision and modality budget are recorded.
dependencies: Existing router adapter and token accounting

finance.title: PURIQ and advisory: governed enterprise access

sources.title: Workday headless agent platform
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: Requires customer tenant and appropriate Workday entitlement; no SZL access established.

developments.source_fact: Workday announced generally available MCP tools, live data querying and agent runtime components carrying enterprise permissions and audit context.
developments.product_inference: Keep actor identity, authorization and approvals attached to financial/advisory tool calls; this is an architecture opportunity, not acquired data access.

opportunities.title: Carry delegated authorization through A11oy
opportunities.proposal: Evaluate a tenant-scoped read adapter after access is confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: Different user entitlements produce correctly restricted results.
Approval-required writes remain pending.
Audit evidence connects actor, tool, source and result.

sources.title: Eleventh Circuit PACER maintenance notice
sources.verification_method: Primary publisher page reviewed during research on 2026-10-13.
sources.access_note: Notice of possible disruption, not proof of actual outage or a deadline change.

developments.source_fact: An October 8 court notice warned of possible PACER/CM/ECF disruption on October 11, 6:55 a.m.-7 p.m. Eastern.
developments.product_inference: Make docket refresh age and interruption recovery visible; do not infer deadline changes from source unavailability.

opportunities.title: Resume docket refresh after interruptions
opportunities.proposal: Preserve the last successful cursor and expose stale-data state.
acceptance_criteria: Restarting refresh does not duplicate docket events.
Unavailable refresh is labelled stale.
Source outage cannot automatically alter a legal deadline.
